name: Skill Eval: debug-skills (issue #171)
description: Four-arm eval for debug-skills. Measures skill-vs-terse delta for debugging tasks. Run with: sin-code eval run --dataset evals/skill-debug.json --arm baseline,terse,lazy_skill,skill-debug-deep

test_cases.prompt: Debug a Go function that has a data race on a shared counter. Identify the root cause and propose a fix.
test_cases.description: skill-debug-deep should use sin_scout + sin_grasp for RCA and sin_poc for fix verification.

test_cases.prompt: Debug a nil pointer dereference in a Go HTTP handler. Show the root cause and minimal fix.
test_cases.description: skill-debug-deep should trace the nil origin and propose a minimal safe fix.
